login.title: Log in
account.title: My account: {name}
log.title: Change log
users.title: Users
users.help.html: Administrator: full access. View only: routers, charts and the whitelist without the ability to change anything; cannot see router tokens, the log or settings.
wl.title: Whitelist
wl.help.html: The router downloads the list every 5 minutes and writes it to /ip firewall address-list (list whitelist). An entry can apply to all routers or to one selected router. The router resolves domains itself through its own DNS and adds the IP addresses it finds as dynamic entries.
wl.import_help.html: One line = one entry: address,description,expiry,router. Address: IPv4, network (CIDR) or domain. Expiry: number of days or a date YYYY-MM-DD (valid until the end of that day). Description, expiry and router are optional; an unknown router name = the line is rejected. Duplicates are skipped.
rt.title: Routers
rt.name: Router name
rt.edge_help: Has a direct connection to the internet (e.g. the main router). Measures internet quality and runs the nightly speed test. Leave APs and routers behind it unchecked – they only measure the link to their own gateway.
rt.after_add: After adding, the router page opens with a configuration command to paste into the RouterOS terminal.
rt.none_admin: Add the first one and you will find its configuration command on its page.
rt.logs_title: Unacknowledged log entries from the last 24 h - click to open the logs
rt.nodata: No data, the router has not reported yet.
set.https.title: HTTPS settings
set.https.help: Requirements: the domain's DNS record points to this server, ports 80 and 443 are reachable from the internet. The certificate is obtained and renewed automatically. Leaving the domain empty = back to plain HTTP. HTTP access (e.g. for routers by IP) stays active.
set.iv.title: Monitoring interval
set.iv.dlg_1: An option for routers with spare CPU and RAM. You apply this setting at your own risk.
set.iv.dlg_2: The interval applies to all routers. At 1–5 s the database grows several to a dozen times faster (consider a shorter RETENTION_DAYS in the .env file). Watch the routers' CPU load after the change.
set.iv.after: After the change, paste the configuration command again on every router (router page → Router configuration). A shorter interval = more data in the database; charts for longer ranges are averaged.
set.wl.title: Whitelist
set.wl.help: When disabled: the Whitelist tab disappears from the menu and the configuration command does not install the sync script on routers (the list is no longer fetched every 5 minutes). After the change, paste the configuration command again on the routers. Disabling does not delete entries, neither in the panel nor on the routers.
set.sp.title: Speed test
set.sp.router: The application server is on this router's network
set.sp.na: Ookla speedtest is not available in this container.
set.sp.help_ookla: Speedtest by Ookla is built into this container: the same test as speedtest.net (download, upload, ping, jitter, packet loss, result link). The Ookla licence allows personal, non-commercial use.
set.sp.help_no.html: The Ookla program was not downloaded while building the container (no internet or unsupported architecture) – the fallback test is used. Rebuild the container: docker compose build --no-cache app.
set.sp.help_tail: If the Ookla test fails, the fallback test is run automatically. The test runs daily at {time} and with the button on the router page (Charts → Link quality). Other edge routers run a simpler test on the router itself.
set.order.title: Router order
set.order.help: This order applies on the home page. New routers are added at the end of the list.
set.bk.title: Database backups
set.bk.noaccess.html: The backup directory is not available. Check that docker-compose.yml has the volume ./backups:/backups and run docker compose up -d.
set.bk.auto.html: Automatically every day at {hour}:00, kept for {keep} days · backups: {count} ({total})
set.bk.failed.html: The last backup attempt failed ({err}). Check: docker compose logs backup
set.bk.stale.html: No recent backup (older than 2 days or none). Check that the backup container is running: docker compose ps
set.bk.help.html: Backups are stored on the same server (the backups directory next to docker-compose.yml). For safety, download a backup to another computer from time to time. Also keep the .env file: without it (SECRET_KEY, passwords) restoring is harder. Restore instructions are in README.md.
lv.help: In setup mode the routers measure Wi-Fi and the gateway connection every 2–3 seconds. Enabling it also covers the CAPsMAN controller (it sees the clients of all APs). When the time runs out, everything returns to normal mode on its own. The router starts fast measurements within about 10 seconds.
lv.spot_ph: Spot name, e.g. Living room by the window
lv.spot_help: Stand in the spot, wait about 30 seconds and save the measurement. The average of the last 30 seconds is saved.
lv.name: Name
lv.inactive: inactive, data about once a minute
lv.stale: – the router is not sending fast Wi-Fi readings
lv.gw_empty: Will appear after setup mode is enabled.
